//: D4.50. How a protection got into a document, and what the document must say about it when the user did not choose it. Read only by backend/services/protectionDecisions.js. Which clause ids play which protection role is routing, kept in backend/commercial/protectionLibrary.js (PROTECTION_ROLE_CLAUSE_IDS) and not repeated here. A protection is never removed because the user did not select it; when no answer of the user's governs it, it is recorded and disclosed as a drafting default, so that an unapproved commercial position is never presented silently as an agreed term. Nothing here says a protection is legally required: no verified authority says so for any of them.

LIABILITY_CAP.label: limitation of liability
LIABILITY_CAP.what_it_does: It limits how much one party can recover from the other.

INDEMNITY.label: indemnity
INDEMNITY.what_it_does: It makes a party responsible for covering the other's losses in the circumstances it describes.

FORCE_MAJEURE.label: force majeure
FORCE_MAJEURE.what_it_does: It excuses a party's failure to perform when events beyond its control prevent performance.

IP_OWNERSHIP.label: intellectual property ownership
IP_OWNERSHIP.what_it_does: It decides who owns intellectual property created under the agreement.

LATE_PAYMENT_INTEREST.label: late payment interest
LATE_PAYMENT_INTEREST.what_it_does: It charges interest on payments made late.

TERMINATION_NOTICE.label: termination notice
TERMINATION_NOTICE.what_it_does: It requires notice before the agreement is ended.

blueprint.sentence: is part of LegalAId's standard template for this type of document

hardening_baseline.sentence: was added by LegalAId because its drafting policy treats it as a standard provision for this type of document

dependency_resolver.sentence: was added by LegalAId because another clause in this document is drafted to be used with it

commercial_engine.sentence: was added automatically because LegalAId treats this as a commercial agreement

deterministic_repair.sentence: was added automatically after the draft was checked, because the checks recommend it for this type of document

unrecorded.sentence: is in this draft, and the draft does not record how it was added

disclosure: The {label} provision ("{title}") {origin_sentence}. You were not asked whether to include it, so it is not yet a term either party has chosen. {what_it_does} Confirm, change or remove it before signing.
disclosure_when_declined: You answered that you did not want a {label} provision, but this draft still contains one ("{title}"): it {origin_sentence}, and your answer did not remove it. {what_it_does} Remove it or have it reviewed before signing.
//disclosure_when_declined: The MOU asks whether to add force majeure and its blueprint includes the clause whatever the answer. That contradiction is recorded and held open in governance/declined-protections.json; until it is decided, the document says plainly that the user's answer was not followed, instead of telling them they were never asked.
